body.name: Total modulus affine estimator on positive-variance radii
body.construction: \(\mathcal R_+=\{r>0:\omega'_{\Sigma_{\mathrm{nest}}}(r)>0,\ \|Kh_r\|_{\Sigma_{\mathrm{nest}}^{-1}}=r\}\). For \(r\in\mathcal R_+\), \(\widehat\theta_r=\{\omega'_{\Sigma_{\mathrm{nest}}}(r)/r\}\langle Kh_r,Z\rangle_{\Sigma_{\mathrm{nest}}^{-1}}\), \(b_r=\{\omega_{\Sigma_{\mathrm{nest}}}(r)-r\omega'_{\Sigma_{\mathrm{nest}}}(r)\}/2\), and \(s_r=\omega'_{\Sigma_{\mathrm{nest}}}(r)>0\). Choose deterministic sequences \(r_{\mathrm{MSE},j},r_{\mathrm{CI},j}\in\mathcal R_+\) satisfying \(b_{r_{\mathrm{MSE},j}}^2+s_{r_{\mathrm{MSE},j}}^2\le(1+j^{-1})\inf_{r\in\mathcal R_+}(b_r^2+s_r^2)\) and \(s_{r_{\mathrm{CI},j}}\operatorname{cv}_{\alpha}(b_{r_{\mathrm{CI},j}}/s_{r_{\mathrm{CI},j}})\le(1+j^{-1})\inf_{r\in\mathcal R_+}s_r\operatorname{cv}_{\alpha}(b_r/s_r)\).
